findings.title: client-agent TCP length prefix has no bounds check; positive oversized frames overflow stack before crypto
findings.description: Agent TCP path reads a plaintext int32_t netsize_t length then recv()s that many bytes into char buffer[OS_MAXSTR+1] with no check that 1 <= length <= OS_MAXSTR. Remoted rejects length > OS_MAXSTR (still misses <=0). Agent accepts positive lengths remoted would drop (e.g. 7000), overflowing the stack buffer before ReadSecMSG/Blowfish. Framing is unauthenticated relative to the agent key.
findings.impact: On-path/MITM or manager-IP redirect attacker causes agent crash; plausible code execution. Windows agent runs as LocalSystem; Linux as ossec in chroot.
findings.attack_path:
1. Agent uses TCP to manager.
2. Attacker MITMs or redirects agent TCP session.
3. Send int32 length=7000 (or -1) then payload.
4. recv writes past stack buffer before any decrypt/auth.
5. Crash / memory corruption in agent process.
findings.remediation: Require length > 0 && length <= OS_MAXSTR (and <= sizeof(buffer)-1) before recv; close socket on violation. Fix remoted length <= 0 as well.
findings.distinct_from: Remoted signed length gap (upper bound exists). This is agent-side zero validation including positive oversized frames.

findings.title: remoted secure TCP unbounded accepts + ErrorExit on accept failure enables unauthenticated daemon kill
findings.description: Secure TCP remoted accept()s every connection into epoll with no connection cap and no idle timeout. When accept fails after FD exhaustion (EMFILE/ENFILE), ErrorExit(ACCEPT_ERROR) terminates remoted. Syslog-TCP continues on accept failure; secure TCP does not.
findings.impact: Unauthenticated attacker holding ~ulimit TCP connections kills remoted; all agents lose the manager channel until external restart.
findings.attack_path:
1. Manager runs secure remoted with protocol tcp.
2. Attacker opens and holds many TCP connections to remoted, sending no data.
3. FD table exhausts; accept returns -1.
4. ErrorExit kills remoted.
findings.remediation: Log and continue on recoverable accept errors; cap unauthenticated connections; set idle timeouts; never ErrorExit for EMFILE/ENFILE/EINTR/ECONNABORTED on the live accept loop.
